title: Frobenius certificates for the Galois group of x(x-1)...(x-p+1)+1
description:
A working research paper on f_p(x)=x(x-1)...(x-p+1)+1 for odd primes p. An odd Frobenius with a fixed-point count different from one certifies S_p, using a classification result in prime degree. The no-root condition is automatic at q<p for this family.

A reduced resultant proves periodicity. Exact congruence coverage has Dirichlet densities 1/2, 31/40, and 7117/8064 using q=3, q=3,5, and q=3,5,7. The joint events are dependent. Explicit certificates cover all 664,577 primes 5<=p<10^7, including a special p=5 factorization; a separate p=3 proof completes all 664,578 odd primes below the bound. Classical Jordan certificates cover the 236 primes 7<=p<1500 without classification.

For (x)_p+c, prime p>=5, p not dividing c, and |c| strictly between the two smallest critical magnitudes, exactly two roots are non-real and the group is S_p. The paper proves a lower bound for the number of such constants. The all-prime conjecture and limiting coverage remain unresolved. The optional Lean supplement proves only the affine fixed-point step.
notes: Version v1.3.0, September 2026. An AI-assisted mathematical and bibliography review has been incorporated; the paper has not been independently refereed.
